open_decisions.question: May source preparation infer a half-unit interval from displayed precision when the rounding rule is unknown?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Separate display precision from the issuer rounding convention; retain unknowns and permit a named conditional nearest-rounding compatibility model with explicit assumption provenance.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat the displayed unit as sufficient evidence for a half-unit interval, or reject all conditional rounding analysis.
open_decisions.consequence: The first overstates source support; the second prevents useful conditional analysis. Existing P02 and the general contract are not yet aligned on this distinction.
open_decisions.next_step: Keep precision/convention/tie rules separate in evidence v3/L2. P17 dispositions source-specific P02 assumptions; conditional half-unit intervals stay explicitly assumed until source support exists.

disposition_evidence.locator: Cross-contract ownership, precedence, status mapping and dependent company outputs
Explicit retained scope and later phase obligations

open_decisions.p17_disposition: Adapter roles and preservation/licence boundaries are mapped for Arelle, Docling, ACTUS, QuantLib, Z3, ledger, tax and probabilistic tools; runtime integration is deferred.
open_decisions.p17_evidence: P17 software-reuse-methods-v1 reuses inspected source; P19 checks source/licence/evaluation specifications. Runtime evaluation needs later implementation authorization.

limitations: P17 is a governing proposal specification with finite document calculations and inspected source evidence. It does not implement runtime domain engines, certify accounting compliance, establish current US/ASBE authority where blocked, close real-package/conflict gaps, validate forecasts or establish human acceptance. Synthetic cases are not real-company evidence; source and method status remain claim-specific.
candidate_initial_profile: CorporateJointHistory/1 with typed corporate authoring and portable IR; P17 adds later domain method obligations without shrinking them.
profile_alternative: A typed-library/shared-IR first release with later text authoring and domain adapters.
selection_question: Can the connected profile and method interfaces cover whole-company histories while preserving source, alternatives, authority and sector-specific state?
